campaign_start_postponed.meaning: the campaign start was postponed so the campaign starts in a few days rather than at the initial startTimestamp

campaign_override_exists.meaning: a campaign override exists for the campaign

override_campaign_allowed.meaning: overrideCampaign() is allowed to complete the valid configuration update considering the new timestamp

override_campaign_not_allowed_observed.meaning: overrideCampaign() is not allowed, i.e. the valid configuration update is rejected

assumptions: The campaign override exists when overrideCampaign() is called, as stated by the intent source.
The new postponed start timestamp is a valid configuration update that should be accepted.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact numeric values of duration, initial startTimestamp, or postponed startTimestamp, so the timestamp comparison cannot be encoded numerically.
Report does not specify whether the caller is the owner or operator in the described scenario.

limitations: The timestamp threshold relation is represented by the grounded Boolean override_campaign_allowed rather than a numeric comparison because the report gives no numeric timestamp values.
Only the selected impact override_campaign_not_allowed is formalized; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
